newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Information completes 1.2 mln shr placement.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Information completes 1.2 mln shr placement.

text.p: Thermo Information Solutions Inc said on Monday that it completed private placements of 1.2 million shares of common stock at $9.00 per share.

Thermo Information, a subsidiary of Coleman Research Corp, which is a wholly owned subsidiary of Thermo Electron Corp said it would use net proceeds from the offering of $10 million for research and development and other general corporate purposes, including possible acquisitions.
The private placements were arranged by KSH Investment Group Inc.
Coleman Research owns 81 percent of Thermo Information Solution's outstanding common stock.
